item.text: {"role":"visual","inspection_scope":"Rough motif-gold-v1 review of the supplied ordered native-frame sheets in both caption modes, supplemented by the supplied full-rate action-region pixel-delta observations. Reviewed only painted visual evidence; no video playback or audio was watched/listened to.","gates":[{"gate":"character-performance","status":"FAIL","evidence":"q01, q02, q03 and q04 show readable head/body tilt or compression after subscription, but q05 remains upright and neutral throughout despite the required burdened role."},{"gate":"physicality","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Earlier shots show the control changing from Upgrade to Subscribed and receipts appearing nearby, but q05 supplies neither a readable control response nor the consequential receipt arrival after the listed contact."},{"gate":"energy","status":"FAIL","evidence":"q01–q04 contain developing action and reactions. In q05, full-rate observations are essentially unchanged from 10.1–12.4s, producing a roughly 2.4-second dead hold with no developing visual idea."},{"gate":"art","status":"PASS","evidence":"The hinged paper pricing placards, layered notes/receipts, tiled wall and wooden shelf retain distinct material and silhouette identities in both caption modes."},{"gate":"composition","status":"FAIL","evidence":"q03 reduces the pricing-and-receipt subject to a small wall thumbnail amid a broad empty tiled field, so the feature explaining the sentence no longer commands attention. The five resets also repeat nearly the same front-on staging rather than sustaining the accumulating burden."},{"gate":"mobile","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Without captions, q01, q02 and q04 communicate subscription followed by receipt accumulation, but q03 makes the pricing and receipt evidence too small to read at native 360×640, while q05 omits the receipts entirely."}],"violations":[{"timestamp":10.8,"shot":"q05","gate":"character-performance","observation":"Bot is upright with a neutral open stance and bright face; there is no compressed body, lowered head, inward arms or antenna droop expressing financial burden.","gold_id":"payment-burden","smallest_correction":"End q05 with Bot visibly compressed beneath or beside the receipts: lower the head and antennae, draw the arms inward and shift the torso toward the pile."},{"timestamp":11.133,"shot":"q05","gate":"physicality","observation":"At the listed contact interval the button still reads Upgrade, no receipts arrive, and no bounded control or nearby-object response establishes cause and effect.","gold_id":"payment-burden","smallest_correction":"Depress the control at contact, change it to Subscribed, then introduce at least one visibly landing receipt with a small local paper/control response."},{"timestamp":10.1,"shot":"q05","gate":"energy","observation":"After the shot reset, the action region remains virtually unchanged through the ending; the supplied trace establishes about 2.4 seconds of dead hold without receipt arrival, character reaction or residual settling.","gold_id":"basement-completion","smallest_correction":"Run the subscribe-to-receipt consequence during q05 and carry a brief paper settle and antenna lag through the final hold."},{"timestamp":5.0,"shot":"q03","gate":"composition","observation":"The pricing placard and receipts are scaled to a tiny wall element while most of the frame is empty tile, breaking focal hierarchy for the billing idea.","gold_id":"payment-burden","smallest_correction":"Keep the pricing placard and receipt pile at subject scale, or crop closer so they and Bot occupy the central action region."},{"timestamp":7.5,"shot":"q04","gate":"composition","observation":"The sequence resets to the same clean pricing-board setup after q03 instead of visually preserving the growing pile, weakening the intended cumulative staging.","gold_id":"payment-burden","smallest_correction":"Carry the existing receipts into q04 and add new ones rather than resetting the board and shelf."},{"timestamp":5.0,"shot":"q03","gate":"mobile","observation":"In the no-caption render, pricing labels, control state and receipt details are too small to identify reliably at 360×640.","gold_id":"payment-burden","smallest_correction":"Enlarge the pricing and receipt cluster to approximately the subject scale used in q01/q02/q04."},{"timestamp":12.1,"shot":"q05","gate":"mobile","observation":"The no-caption ending contains a pricing panel and neutral Bot but no visible recurring-bill pile, so the essential meaning does not survive without text.","gold_id":"payment-burden","smallest_correction":"Retain a conspicuous asymmetric receipt stack in the ending and pose Bot in direct relation to it."}],"sampling_limits":"Ordered sheets sample selected frames rather than every pose and cannot prove interpolation, timing feel, grip tracking between samples or audio synchronization. The supplied pixel-delta traces establish changed versus nearly unchanged regions but are not semantic motion evidence. Caption and no-caption sheets were both inspected; no MP4 playback was performed."}
